title: Turn failure, exit and Stop transfer mailbox wake ownership atomically: split restore-unsent from open-recovery-episode, and treat channel-accepted ambiguity as unknown
outcome:
Every turn failure, runtime exit and Stop path changes the mailbox wake's ownership through the transition owner (w-e157f102bbec) in one persisted image. None clears the active boundary, commits, and then relies on a later best-effort requeue.
- A known pre-send rejection closes that exact attempt as not sent and restores the same obligation.
- A failure, exit or Stop after a confirmed handoff opens an explicitly identified recovery episode for the eligible unread scope, keeping the delivery history and the existing Stop/failure suspension. If the mail was already acknowledged, no recovery episode is opened.
- Where the command channel accepted the prompt but the provider's start is uncertain (the Codex turn/start error and the missing turn/started watchdog), the outcome is unknown and is never treated as not sent.
- requeue_rejected_mailbox_notification is split into these two distinct commands.
- The pre-existing gap where start_turn_on_record sets the active boundary and can then return Err without resetting it is closed.

Provenance: Architect2's structural decision f639826d on w-3bd74078208d; item 2 of the decomposition in TermAl mailbox 03723eab #42, accepted in #43. Read-only map: the boundary is taken, committed, then requeued in a separate step at turn_lifecycle.rs 590/893/1440/1792/2152 and session_lifecycle.rs 1100. The requeue helper serves pre-send rejection (api.rs 95: five causes) and post-acceptance failure (seven sites). The start_turn_on_record gap is at turn_dispatch.rs 354-365 and 515-533.
Review findings it carries:
- round-1 Medium (Codex a52270f5 and Claude 4bd98449): a rejected handoff of an acknowledged continuation loses the wake;
- round-3 Medium (Claude 34e81e3e): after a delivered turn fails, is Stopped or dies, reads say delivered although a recovered or held wake is queued (with the D5 projection).
Criteria to be proposed by the holder and concurred by the coordinator.
acceptance: Turn failure, exit and Stop transfer mailbox wake ownership atomically: split restore-unsent from open-recovery-episode, and treat channel-accepted ambiguity as unknown is done
